_comment: Wallpapers whose difference from Wallpaper Engine is known and not a parity target: owe_compare reports a DIFF among these as RAND (random by design) or CTRL (control), counted apart from 'differ'. Delete an entry, or this file, to count them as DIFF again. Reasons: wpe-parity-comparer compare/OWE_PARITY.md.

random.particles-layerimage-lattice: random node picks with repetition leave ~9% of lattice nodes empty, different ones each run (placement matches)

control.shadow-thin-sweep: sub-texel shadow coverage, cause unknown: casters thinner than a shadow texel cover different texels in WE and owe (shadow-thin-sweep: WE shadows posts #8 and #13 of 16, owe #13 only), while thick casters and the texel grid match; unchanged by #196 (OWE_PARITY 2026-11-10)
control.shadow-cascade-switch-wide-first: sub-texel shadow coverage, cause unknown: casters thinner than a shadow texel cover different texels in WE and owe (shadow-thin-sweep: WE shadows posts #8 and #13 of 16, owe #13 only), while thick casters and the texel grid match; unchanged by #196 (OWE_PARITY 2026-11-10); 0.9977/0.9978 on the VM at medium, 0.9989 under DXVK at ultra

driver.shadow-courtyard-arch: suspected GPU/driver depth-slope difference: light leaking under a wall's own shadow at its foot is brighter in WE (repro shadow-courtyard-arch-flat-slab; OWE_PARITY 'a leak line at a wall's foot')
